name: glass-dimension
vibe: A premium glassmorphism depth film. Layered frosted-glass panels float at layered depth over a soft drifting field of accent light-orbs — blur, translucency, thin luminous borders and soft inner glow. Titles, stat cards and screenshots all live inside frosted-glass surfaces; the light field behind is what the glass refracts. Everything is theme-driven, so the brand color repaints the whole film — the light behind the glass, the panel tints, the borders, the glows and the CTA, not just the text. Portrait-native 9:16 for Reels, Shorts and TikTok. Rendered as a native GSAP + canvas composition. Best for modern SaaS, apps and premium products that should feel clean, deep and iOS-like.
